requirement: Implement v1.3 EPIC 4 Story 2: make on-screen pad practice comfortable and legible on touch devices.

architecture.decision: Extend the existing pad verdict props with a short-lived miss state, trigger native haptics only on correct hits, and enlarge the existing pad on coarse pointers.
tradeoffs: Reusing the current hit timer/pad prop flow keeps the pad a display and signal-emitter surface while scoring stays in useLiveInput.
seams: BeatPad and CSS render state and target sizing

tasks.title: Touch-enhance practice pad
tasks.intent: Give tablet learners clear hit/miss feedback, a native success haptic, and comfortably large pad targets.
tasks.acceptance: Correct practice taps flash green and request a short haptic where supported; wrong/late taps flash a distinct miss state; coarse-pointer pad targets are enlarged; the existing cue remains visible.
verify: CSS and source inspection for haptic/miss/coarse-pointer paths
tasks.visual: Run the Vite app and inspect the pad at desktop and tablet dimensions.
tasks.result: Added a mutually exclusive miss verdict alongside the existing hit verdict, native 12ms correct-hit haptics, and coarse-pointer visualizer sizing that restores the 300px pad geometry floor.
evidence: npm run build — passed (tsc && vite build)

Source inspection — missPad flows useLiveInput → App → VisualizerPad → BeatPad; native navigator.vibrate?.(12) is called only for practice hits; .is-miss has red, dashed, and reduced-motion-safe styling.
Live Vite app at http://127.0.0.1:5173/: 12 pad buttons rendered and console had no warnings/errors at desktop and 768px tablet dimensions. The browser runtime cannot emulate a coarse pointer.
